from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):

                y = 2.2 - i * 0.9
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup the layout with the specific text provided
        lecture_lines_text = [
            "Product rule adds growth; Chain rule multiplies rates.",
            "Visualize rectangles for products and gears for composition.",
            "Master these patterns to tackle any calculus challenge."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Interactive Summary & Visual Recap", lecture_lines_text)

        # Colors
        PRODUCT_COLOR = "#00BFFF" # Deep Sky Blue
        CHAIN_COLOR = "#FF8C00"   # Dark Orange
        MNEMONIC_COLOR = "#00FF00" # Green
        HIGHLIGHT_COLOR = "#FFFF00" # Yellow

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Update lecture line color
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR))

        # Formulas side-by-side
        product_formula = MathTex(r"\frac{d}{dx}[f \cdot g] = f'g + fg'", color=PRODUCT_COLOR)
        chain_formula = MathTex(r"\frac{d}{dx}[f(g(x))] = f'(g(x)) \cdot g'(x)", color=CHAIN_COLOR)

        self.place_in_area(product_formula, "B1", "B3", scale_factor=0.7)
        self.place_in_area(chain_formula, "B4", "B6", scale_factor=0.7)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(product_formula, shift=UP),
            FadeIn(chain_formula, shift=UP)
        )
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        )

        # Rectangle Icon (Product)
        rect_main = Rectangle(width=2, height=1.2, color=PRODUCT_COLOR)
        rect_v_line = Line(rect_main.get_bottom(), rect_main.get_top(), color=PRODUCT_COLOR).shift(LEFT*0.3)
        rect_h_line = Line(rect_main.get_left(), rect_main.get_right(), color=PRODUCT_COLOR).shift(UP*0.2)
        rectangle_icon = VGroup(rect_main, rect_v_line, rect_h_line)
        self.place_in_area(rectangle_icon, "C1", "C3", scale_factor=0.6)

        # Gear Icon (Chain)

        teeth = VGroup(*[
            Rectangle(width=0.15, height=0.2, fill_opacity=1, color=CHAIN_COLOR).move_to(
                gear_base.point_at_angle(a * DEGREES)
            ).rotate(a * DEGREES)

        ])
        gear_icon = VGroup(gear_base, teeth)
        self.place_in_area(gear_icon, "C4", "C6", scale_factor=0.6)

        self.play(Create(rectangle_icon), Create(gear_icon))
        self.wait(1)

        # Merge into master Calculus Rules badge
        master_badge_circle = Circle(radius=1.2, color=WHITE, stroke_width=4)
        master_text = Text("Calculus Rules", font_size=24, color=WHITE)
        master_group = VGroup(master_badge_circle, master_text)
        self.place_in_area(master_group, "D2", "E5", scale_factor=1.0)

        # Highlight key derivative symbols in neon
        d_dx_symbol = MathTex(r"\frac{d}{dx}", color="#FF00FF").scale(1.5) # Neon Magenta
        self.place_at_grid(d_dx_symbol, "D4")

        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(rectangle_icon, master_group),
            ReplacementTransform(gear_icon, master_group),
            FadeOut(product_formula),
            FadeOut(chain_formula)
        )
        self.play(Write(d_dx_symbol))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        )

        mnemonic_text = Text(
            "Add Growth for Products, Multiply Rates for Chains", 
            font_size=20, 
            color=MNEMONIC_COLOR
        )
        self.place_in_area(mnemonic_text, "F1", "F6", scale_factor=1.0)

        self.play(FadeIn(mnemonic_text, scale=1.2))
        self.wait(3)

        # Final Cleanup: revert highlight
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        self.wait(2)
